content: Ant chalk, also referred to as Chinese chalk or Miraculous Insecticide Chalk, is an insecticide that resembles ordinary chalk in appearance. This product contains the active pesticide ingredients deltamethrin and cypermethrin. While these chemical compounds are legally approved for use in the United States, the sale and distribution of ant chalk itself have been prohibited. This ban is due to several significant concerns, including numerous cases of child poisoning reported during the time the product was legally available, the toxic lead-based packaging in which the product is sold, and the improper labeling on the packaging that fails to meet regulatory standards. The term Chinese chalk is used because, despite its illegal status in the United States, the product continues to be imported from China and is often sold in Chinatowns across the country.
